card.name: Anniversary and bicentennial phrases
card.fires_on: Words in a commemoration of a historical milestone, such as 'years', 'th', 'anniversary' or 'of' after a number of years, and the middle of 'Bicentennial'.

modes.label: Anniversary wording
modes.description: The word anniversary, or the 'of' right after it, following an ordinal like 40th or 50th.
modes.example: This year marked the 40th anniversary<< of>> the founding of the celebration

modes.label: Counting years
modes.description: The unit or ordinal ending right after a number of years being celebrated.
modes.example: Trinidadians of East Indian descent will celebrate 167<< years>> of their people’s presence on the island

modes.label: Bicentennial
modes.example: Check out our new website for Louis Braille's Bic<<ent>>ennial!

card.plain: It lights up when text marks a milestone anniversary of an event, like the 40th anniversary of a law.
